stories.headline: Iran will stand firm against any aggressor, Pezeshkian says

opening: Iran will stand firm against any aggressor, Pezeshkian says Iran’s president Masoud Pezeshkian said Tehran does not seek war but will stand firmly against any aggressor, stressing that no power can force a nation determined to resist to surrender.

“The Islamic Republic of Iran is not the initiator of war,” he said, adding, “we do not welcome war, but we will stand firmly against any aggressor with strength, and no power can force a nation that is standing with all its strength and determination to surrender.” Pezeshkian said Iran would not bow to threats as it has the backing of diplomatic efforts, the support of the Iranian people, the work of government officials and the sacrifices of comm.
